summary: SNDL Inc., a foreign private issuer (Canadian, Form 40-F filer), furnished a Form 6-K on October 15, 2026 (US equivalent: Form 8-K), reporting 2026 annual and special meeting results and preliminary Q3 results. Shareholders elected all five directors and approved the auditor appointment with 86.2% support, but the special resolution authorizing a potential share consolidation failed with 54.1% in favor versus the required two-thirds. The company announced capital-return initiatives accelerated by record quarterly free cash flow of approximately C$20 million, partly from unwinding a captive insurance arrangement. Watch for the actual buyback/dividend mechanics and confirmation of preliminary figures.
